reason: I still have to watch my mobile-money SMS, confirm each payment and press send in WhatsApp myself, which is exactly what I do today. A nicer page and an expiring link are not worth 4 900 FCFA a month when my buyers already find me on WhatsApp; at most I would try the free page with one product.
objection: If I still have to confirm each payment and send the link myself, what do I gain? The work that eats my evenings stays the same.
would_change_my_mind: Automatic payment confirmation, so the buyer gets the download link by themselves when SasPay receives the money, without me touching anything.
